scope:
Run the actual compact CYD page script, including OTA, Wi-Fi and time edits.

Browser DOM/fetch/WebSocket boundaries are controlled Node seams. Semantic
mutants run only against frozen alternate page files; production is unchanged.
These tests do not replace browser layout or physical-device qualification.

drop_other_profiles.case: Wi-Fi first-row editor preserves all five IDs and omits untouched SSIDs and passwords
command: ^Wi\-Fi\ first\-row\ editor\ preserves\ all\ five\ IDs\ and\ omits\ untouched\ SSIDs\ and\ passwords$

rewrite_legacy_ssid.case: unchanged non-UTF8 legacy SSID presentation is omitted even when replacement text exceeds the byte cap
command: ^unchanged\ non\-UTF8\ legacy\ SSID\ presentation\ is\ omitted\ even\ when\ replacement\ text\ exceeds\ the\ byte\ cap$

blank_password_clears.case: Wi-Fi blank password keeps existing secret and persistence failure keeps the new input
command: ^Wi\-Fi\ blank\ password\ keeps\ existing\ secret\ and\ persistence\ failure\ keeps\ the\ new\ input$

implicit_open.case: open network requires an explicit action and sends set with an empty password
command: ^open\ network\ requires\ an\ explicit\ action\ and\ sends\ set\ with\ an\ empty\ password$

wrong_offset_sign.case: time saves exact four query fields without a body and announces persistence without claiming synchronization
command: ^time\ saves\ exact\ four\ query\ fields\ without\ a\ body\ and\ announces\ persistence\ without\ claiming\ synchronization$

stale_time_response.case: periodic polling is sequential and an old time GET cannot overwrite a completed edit
command: ^periodic\ polling\ is\ sequential\ and\ an\ old\ time\ GET\ cannot\ overwrite\ a\ completed\ edit$

overlapping_polls.case: periodic polling is sequential and an old time GET cannot overwrite a completed edit
command: ^periodic\ polling\ is\ sequential\ and\ an\ old\ time\ GET\ cannot\ overwrite\ a\ completed\ edit$

legacy_capability_fallback.case: legacy upload capability does not enable native Wi-Fi editing and unconfirmed success never claims restart
command: ^legacy\ upload\ capability\ does\ not\ enable\ native\ Wi\-Fi\ editing\ and\ unconfirmed\ success\ never\ claims\ restart$
